font-size:0 is also an inline-block spacing hack: a descendant restoring a non-zero size does render, so its text is kept

```dart title="Dart"

import 'package:h2m/h2m.dart';
import 'package:h2m/src/html_to_markdown_rs_bridge_generated/frb_generated.dart' show RustLib;
Future<void> main() async {
  await RustLib.init();
  try {
    final options = await createConversionOptionsFromJson(json: '{}');
    final result = await H2mBridge.convert('<div style="font-size:0"><span style="font-size:14px">restored and visible</span></div>', options: options);
    stdout.writeln(result.content);
  } finally {
    RustLib.dispose();
  }
}
```
